text.line.m.a1.01.dawn.1: First light, and the fog is already in the cranes. Tow truck is warm. Come to the gate.
text.line.m.a1.01.gate: There you are. Keys are in the truck by the gate.
text.line.m.a1.01.hook: Hooked. Easy now, nobody rushes a tow.
text.line.m.a1.01.pod.1: Hold on. This car has no driver, no plate, and a box bolted under the seat.
text.line.m.a1.01.pod.2: Whatever this is, the fog is not the only thing hiding in the Yard today.
text.line.m.a1.01.radio: Dispatch says a robotaxi quit on Third Street and is blocking the lane. Free tow if you beat the company truck.
text.line.m.a1.01.tow: Bring it home slow. Nothing on it gets scratched.
text.line.m.a1.01.truck: Take the truck. It idles rough, so give it a minute.
text.mission.m.a1.01.fail.ko: You went down. Get up and try again.
text.mission.m.a1.01.fail.pod: The stalled car is wrecked. Start the tow again.
text.mission.m.a1.01.fail.tow: The tow truck is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.01.obj.deliver_pod: Tow the stalled car back to the Yard
text.mission.m.a1.01.obj.enter_tow_again: Get back in the tow truck
text.mission.m.a1.01.obj.goto_stall: Pull up beside the stalled robotaxi on Third Street
text.mission.m.a1.01.title: Jump Start
